Maintaining the Prometheus2Heraclitus collection

Prometheus2Heraclitus is a collection of actual reusable Skills. Each member under skills/ owns its entrypoint, methods, references, documents, diagrams, scripts, and other supporting resources. Independent members retain their own purpose and specialist responsibilities. Collection membership does not make every resource part of Yinyang or impose its philosophical account.

The collection offers its working Skills as examples for adoption, combination, and independent authorship. Yinyang's philosophy is this example's developed account, not a required worldview for recipients. Its literary/philosophical form can inspire a differently organized work. Preserve the distinction between maintaining the existing implementation and authoring another one. The website projects selected source documents and diagrams; maintain their meaning here, with source revision and rights traceable in that reading surface.

The root README editions are the collection entrance. Keep their descriptions aligned with the actual members and preserve full semantic parity. English is the first reading language for English-capable readers and models; model-facing maintenance prose remains English.

Yinyang's MODEL.md owns interpretation of that Skill's philosophical claims, formation method, reader editions, and supporting resources. Its documents and diagrams live inside skills/yinyang/references/. Other members keep their own instructions and resources. Do not import another repository's philosophical content merely to follow its directory organization.

Publication boundary

The owner selected a fresh public history for the noncommercial Yinyang edition on 2026-10-14. Preserve the private recovery archive and build future public changes on the current public main. Do not merge pre-replacement branches back into public ancestry; reapply any needed contributions onto the current tree. Replacing history reduces ordinary access to prior versions but cannot revoke earlier license grants or erase copies and caches outside this repository.

Complete website source in the collection

website/ holds the public website's complete committed material and implementation: rendered reading pages, static assets, runtime code, build integration, dependencies and migrations. It is generated from one exact native Sites Git commit. Only .playwright-cli/, design-evidence/, and design-qa.md are omitted as QA probes. Tracked dist/ is public static source and must remain; ignored client/server build output, caches, local secrets and live applicant databases are not source material. website/SOURCE.json records the source commit and exclusions. The empty .env.example is a template; .openai/hosting.json contains nonsecret project and binding identifiers. Independent deployment requires its own Site ID and runtime secrets.

The native Site repository owns presentation, implementation, and its publication helper. Canonical Yinyang philosophical prose and the practical guide live at skills/yinyang/; copies and rendered editions inside website/ are generated projections, not a second authoring owner. Their displayed canonical revision can precede the snapshot commit when content is unchanged. Maintain original content at its owner and regenerate before publishing.

Follow the native Site README's publication route when preparing publication; it owns the content/runtime selection and the Git-first runtime route with archive fallback for this Site. Commit and push the final Site source. Ordinary content activates its exact immutable snapshot without a Worker build or native Sites deployment; runtime changes publish that exact source through the native workflow. Apply its source snapshot with python scripts/sync-website.py --source /path/to/site --revision FULL_SHA --apply, then run the same command without --apply to check path coverage, bytes and modes. Review and publish the collection change to GitHub separately, then verify the selected content manifest or native Site version through its owning route. Skip unchanged snapshots and deployments. This is an explicit publication workflow, not a new watcher or automatic GitHub push service. Never edit generated snapshot copies.

The collection is published as a clean public GitHub repository. Anyone may view, clone, and download it without an application, invitation, download code, or continuing-access grant. Historical private source must stay in its private archive; never publish excluded manuscripts or private records through history. GitHub supplies source archives and independent forks. This collection accepts conversation through Issues and does not accept pull requests of any kind; the author owns revisions and publication. Song requests are for boluopai only, not recording submissions. CONTRIBUTING.md owns the reader-facing guidance. The website presents reading editions and package introductions; all source and downloads go to GitHub package directories or its native repository ZIP. Codex recipients normally install selected plugins from the boluopai GitHub marketplace; archives remain an optional source route. Keep the installation entrance and commands in the GitHub README and docs/codex editions. The website is for reading and introductions, with source links to GitHub; do not repeat installation buttons across its pages or maintain a separate website installer. The catalog at .agents/plugins/marketplace.json owns plugin identity, version and presentation. scripts/build-plugins.py --apply assembles complete portable packages in plugins/ from tracked skills/ sources; its default mode checks byte, mode and coverage equality. Do not edit generated plugin copies. Increment the affected plugin version when its shipped content changes, regenerate, check native installation and discovery, then publish the source and generated packages together. No separate GitHub Release or tag workflow is required. Official directory submission uses a ZIP of the same generated plugin; it is a publisher artifact, not a website download service. Keep private personal adaptations outside plugin caches and never include them in distribution.

Yinyang's original material is licensed under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, governed by the official legal code at https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/legalcode.en. Reproduction, adaptation, and distribution are permitted for noncommercial purposes only. When sharing, retain required attribution and notices, provide the license link, and identify changes. Shared adaptations follow the license's ShareAlike conditions; private adaptations need not be published. Preserve the NonCommercial element; do not add a redistribution ban or individual download approval. The reusable method and tool packages other than Yinyang retain their package-local MIT licenses. Their companion relationships do not merge their ownership or licensing. Root LICENSING.md records the mixed scope by material, not platform. Yinyang projections and original philosophical text retain CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 on both GitHub and the website; the other package projections and downloads retain MIT on both surfaces. Independently authored site code, interface design, photos, and audio keep their own stated rights; neither grant automatically covers them. Do not invent a new site-code license. Third-party rights and earlier valid grants remain intact.

Publish only authorized reusable material. Personal accounts, private source quotations, health or psychological records, relationship narratives, accounts, private paths, conversation identifiers, and links exposing those materials stay with their actual private owner. Do not retrieve private personal materials merely to maintain this collection or create a public index that reconstructs a portrait.

Unpublished manuscripts, their reading editions, PDFs, figures, source files, and private source records are excluded from public packages. General ideas may be developed in the existing essays as standalone exposition with independently public references where relevant. Publication of any original or anonymous manuscript requires fresh explicit user authorization. Do not reintroduce excluded source through links, assets, history, or provider previews.

Review the whole public change, including assets, metadata, published Git history, and link destinations. Reusable packages must remain meaningful without private sources. Keep conceptual reading links local to their owning complete package; verify moved references, source locators, and asset paths. Preserve actual permissions, consent, and publication authority.

Do not maintain a download application, approval service, access-code system, publication-secret workflow, or separate package ZIP generator for this collection. Use GitHub's public archive and native collaboration functions. Website reading editions retain their own source and publication workflow.

Maintain each account at its existing owner rather than duplicating it in the collection root. Do not add interpretation registries, automatic personal-data feeds, or synchronization services for this collection.
